items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Buddy took Herschel's place in Basie's band.

ctx.x: And then it seemed like guys like Buddy Tate and Jaquet and that kind of came from Herschel.
Buddy copied Herschel, because Buddy took Herschel's place in Basie's band. And Illinois Jaquet has got a lot of Lester Young in him.
